title: RBI Monetary Penalty on Bank of Baroda and GIC Housing Finance - Fair Practices Code and KYC Violations
description: <cite index="42-1">The RBI imposed a penalty of Rs 63.6 lakh on Bank of Baroda for non-compliance with the Fair Practices Code for Lenders and KYC norms.</cite> <cite index="42-2">A penalty of Rs 3.1 lakh was imposed on GIC Housing Finance Ltd for non-compliance with KYC guidelines.</cite> <cite index="42-5,42-6">Bank of Baroda had charged interest higher than the contracted rate in certain loan accounts and failed to upload KYC records to the Central KYC Records Registry within the prescribed timeline.</cite>
